verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships an official CLI (clickhousectl) that manages local server versions, cloud clusters, ClickPipes, and can install official agent skills into coding agents — directly relevant to AI-native agentic workflows — corroborated by a keyless install/run runtime probe. missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation specifically of clickhousectl (community evidence covers the DB generally, not this CLI tool).
